description: Land Title Settlement Department - Hiththatiya Mada, Matara D/S Division, Matara District - Cad. Map No. 820003 (23/0106)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains a declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement determining ownership of specific land parcels (Parcel Nos. 51-65, 70-83, 86-94, 96-99, 101-102) in Matara District, including details of landowners, property extents, and title classifications. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazette category as it concerns land registrations, property ownership determinations, and land title settlements.
